         AMMONIUM PHOSPHORICUM

       Phosphate of Ammonia


A remedy for chronic gouty patients uric acid diathesis, indicated in
      bronchitis and   nodosities of the joints   of the fingers and
      backs of the hands. Facial paralysis. Pain in shoulder-joint. Tightness around chest.
      Heaviness of limbs, unsteady, tottering gait. Coldness from least draft of air.



Head.--  Sneezing with excessive running from nose and eyes, only
      in morning.



Respiratory.--  Deep rough cough with greenish expectoration.



Urine.--  Rose-colored sediment.



Dose.--  Third decimal trituration.
